Subject: AdWords Account Payment Notification

Dear Advertiser,

A recent payment attempt was unsuccessful.

Advertisements may be suspended if this issue remains unresolved.

To help maintain your campaigns, please update your payment information.

Please log in to your account to review and update your payment details.

Thank you for your continued use of Google AdWords.

spam.instructions: Classify this email as SPAM or NOT_SPAM based on its content.

criteria.SPAM: Unsolicited advertising, phishing, scams, fraudulent offers, or deceptive messages.
criteria.NOT_SPAM: Legitimate personal, business, or informational correspondence.
